# Balaji Rubber Products

> Industrial rubber manufacturer in Bengaluru, India since 2003. Manufacturer of rubber seals, bellows, diaphragms, silicone products, Viton seals, nitrile rubber, polyurethane components, and metal bonded rubber products. ISO 9001 certified. MSME Registered. Custom manufacturing for OEMs and industrial clients across India.

## Products

- [Metal Bonded Rubber Products](/products/metal-bonded-rubber-products): Rubber-to-metal bonded components for vibration isolation, shock absorption, and industrial machinery.
- [Rubber Bellows](/products/rubber-bellows): High-quality rubber bellows for vibration control, expansion joints, pumps and industrial machinery.
- [Rubber Seals & O-Rings](/products/rubber-seals-o-rings): Precision rubber seals and O-rings in NBR, EPDM, Viton & Silicone for hydraulic, pneumatic and industrial applications.
- [Rubber Diaphragm](/products/rubber-diaphragm): Precision molded rubber diaphragms for pumps, valves, actuators and control systems.
- [Nitrile Rubber Products](/products/nitrile-rubber-products): Oil and fuel resistant nitrile rubber (NBR) products for automotive, hydraulic and industrial sealing.
- [Rubber Rice Rollers](/products/rubber-rice-rollers): High-performance rubber rollers for rice milling machines and paddy processing.
- [Rubber Products](/products/rubber-products): Custom rubber products including seals, bellows, diaphragms and molded components.
- [Silicone Rubber Products](/products/silicone-rubber-products): Food and medical grade silicone rubber profiles, cords, tubes and molded components.
- [Silicone Tubes](/products/silicone-tubes): High-quality silicone tubes for food, pharmaceutical, medical and high-temperature applications.
- [Silicone O-Rings](/products/silicone-o-rings): Silicone O-rings with excellent temperature resistance for food, pharma and industrial applications.
- [Silicone Cords](/products/silicone-cords): Flexible silicone rubber cords for sealing, insulation and industrial applications.
- [Silicone Profiles](/products/silicone-profiles): Custom extruded silicone rubber profiles for sealing and high-temperature industrial applications.
- [Viton Rubber Products](/products/viton-rubber-products): High-temperature and chemical resistant Viton rubber components for oil & gas and automotive.
- [Viton Washers](/products/viton-washers): Viton (FKM) washers offering resistance to heat, fuels, oils and aggressive chemicals.
- [Viton O-Rings](/products/viton-o-rings): Viton O-rings with resistance to heat, fuels and chemicals for oil & gas and automotive.
- [Viton Seals](/products/viton-seals): Viton (FKM) rubber seals resistant to high temperature, fuels, oils and aggressive chemicals.
- [Polyurethane Products](/products/polyurethane-products): High-performance polyurethane components with excellent abrasion resistance for heavy-duty applications.
- [Polyurethane Rollers](/products/polyurethane-rollers): Polyurethane rollers with abrasion resistance and long service life for industrial machinery.
- [Castable Polyurethane Products](/products/castable-polyurethane-products): Castable polyurethane components with high abrasion resistance for demanding industrial applications.
- [Polyurethane Diaphragm](/products/polyurethane-diaphragm): Polyurethane diaphragms with flexibility, strength and chemical resistance for pumps and valves.
- [Leveling Leg Bush](/products/leveling-leg-bush): Polyurethane leveling leg bushes for vibration isolation and load support in industrial machinery.

## About

Balaji Rubber Products has been manufacturing industrial rubber and polymer components since 2003. We serve OEMs, industrial manufacturers, engineering companies, and procurement teams across India. Our manufacturing capabilities include custom rubber moulding, compression moulding, injection moulding, polyurethane casting, and metal bonded rubber components.
